content: @vitejs/plugin-react 6.x (Vite 8, oxc transformer) removed the inline babel option. React Compiler via Babel: install @rolldown/plugin-babel, @babel/core, babel-plugin-react-compiler 1.0.0; config plugins: [react(), babel({ presets: [reactCompilerPreset()] })]. Native Rust compiler option react({compiler:true}) via oxc-transform-react is marked experimental (peer ^0.152.0 while latest is 0.153.0).
